answer: Pigment-License Auction, $18 per fake: each identity must buy one unique pigment license — a color-hash minted in a weekly auction with only 500 colors, priced by demand — and anchor it to its public key. A public mirror ledger lists every pigment and owner; two identities sharing one pigment both lose their licenses. Each epoch a random audit demands the owner reproduce its pigment's private salt within 60 seconds; a copied salt fails. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 licenses at $18 each — $18,000 — and the palette cap crowds fakes into visible color clusters.
